proposals.before: That year Nan Baoshou and two others passed the examinations.
proposals.after: That year Nan Chengbao and two others passed the examinations.
proposals.reason: Chinese 南承保 is Nan Chengbao; Baoshou misreads 承保.

proposals.before: That year, jinshi Nan Baoshou and three others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.after: That year, jinshi Nan Chengbao and two others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.reason: Name 南承保 is Nan Chengbao; 三人 means three including the named graduate, not three others.

proposals.before: On renyin day the army halted at Yanyan Pass.
proposals.after: On renyin day the army halted at Yan Gou.
proposals.reason: 鹽溝 is Yan Gou (Salt Ditch), not Yanyan Pass.

proposals.before: On renyin day halted at Yanyan Pass.
proposals.after: On renyin day halted at Yan Gou.
proposals.reason: 鹽溝 is Yan Gou, not Yanyan Pass.

proposals.before: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was sent with a letter in reply.
proposals.after: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Jianzhi was sent with a letter in reply.
proposals.reason: 姚柬之 is Yao Jianzhi; Shuzhi misreads 柬.

proposals.before: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was dispatched with a letter in reply.
proposals.after: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Jianzhi was dispatched with a letter in reply.

proposals.before: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others passed the examinations.
proposals.after: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and two others passed the examinations.
proposals.reason: 三人 means three men total including Li Kefeng.

proposals.before: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.after: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and two others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.reason: 三人 means three total, not three others.

proposals.before: Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
proposals.after: Imperial Consort Hu Nian was confined at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
proposals.reason: 幽 is the verb 'confine', not the place You; 胡輦 was confined (later granted death in s0191), not buried alive; only 餘黨 were buried alive.

proposals.before: Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
proposals.after: Imperial Consort Hu Nian was confined at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.
proposals.reason: 幽 means confine; 生瘞 applies to remaining conspirators, not the consort.

proposals.before: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others passed the examinations.
proposals.after: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-two others passed the examinations.
proposals.reason: 二十三人 means twenty-three total including Yang Ji.

proposals.before: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.after: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-two others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.reason: 二十三人 means twenty-three total.

proposals.before: That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and thirteen others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.after: That year, jinshi Shi Kezhong and twelve others were passed and granted degree.
proposals.reason: 一十三人 means thirteen total including Shi Kezhong; idiomatic already has twelve others.

proposals.before: That year Liu Eryi and two others passed the imperial preliminary examination.
proposals.after: That year Liu Eryi and two others were examined before the throne.
proposals.reason: 御前引試 records the imperial preliminary examination before the throne, not an explicit degree grant (contrast 放進士); 'passed' overstates the Chinese.

proposals.before: That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and three others.
proposals.after: That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and two others (三人 total).
proposals.reason: 等三人 means three persons in total including Liu Eryi, not Liu Eryi plus three others.

decisions.reason: s0011 names 南承保; 承保 is Chengbao, not Baoshou. The idiomatic already correctly treats 三人 as the named graduate plus two others, so the proposed name fix is accurate.
南承保 is Nan Chengbao, and 等三人 means three graduates total including him; the literal wrongly used Baoshou and 'three others.' Both proposed corrections match the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 放進士南承保等三人及第

decisions.reason: 次鹽溝 is a halt at 鹽溝 (Yan Gou, Salt Ditch); Yanyan Pass invents an unattested place name and misreads 溝.
The literal likewise renders 鹽溝 as Yanyan Pass; Yan Gou restores the toponym in the Chinese.
遣監門衛大將軍姚柬之 names Yao Jianzhi (柬之); Shuzhi misreads 柬. The proposed replacement corrects only that name.
The literal field has the same misreading of 姚柬之 as Yao Shuzhi; Yao Jianzhi matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遣監門衛大將軍姚柬之持書往報

decisions.reason: 李可封等三人 means three men total including Li Kefeng, so 'two others' is required; 'three others' overcounts.
The literal likewise treats 三人 as three besides Li Kefeng; the proposed 'two others' matches 等三人.
幽皇太妃胡輦於懷州 uses 幽 as 'confine' and 胡輦 as the consort's name; 生瘞之 applies only to 餘黨. The original invents 'Hu of You' and wrongly has her buried alive; the proposal restores confinement of Hu Nian.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 幽皇太妃胡輦於懷州……餘黨皆生瘞之

decisions.reason: The literal repeats the same errors; 幽 means confine and 生瘞 covers only the remaining conspirators, so the proposed wording matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 幽皇太妃胡輦於懷州，囚夫人夷懶於南京，餘黨皆生瘞之

decisions.reason: 楊佶等二十三人 means twenty-three graduates total including Yang Ji, so twenty-two others is correct; twenty-three others overcounts.
The literal has the same inclusive-count error for 二十三人; 'twenty-two others' matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 放進士楊佶等二十三人及第

decisions.reason: 史克忠等一十三人 is thirteen total including Shi Kezhong; the literal's 'thirteen others' is wrong, while the proposed 'twelve others' aligns with the idiomatic and the Chinese.
御前引試 records examination before the throne, not a 放進士 degree grant; 'passed' overstates the Chinese, and 'were examined before the throne' is accurate without inventing success.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 御前引試劉二宜等三人

decisions.after: That year, imperial preliminary examination of Liu Eryi and two others.
decisions.reason: 等三人 means three persons total including Liu Eryi, so the original 'three others' is wrong; the proposal's count is right, but the parenthetical '(三人 total)' is an editorial gloss unfit for the literal field.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows 南承保 is Nan Chengbao; the Nan Baoshou name claim exists only from the mistranslation and is unsupported by the Chinese.
Accepted r0005 shows 姚柬之 is Yao Jianzhi; the Yao Shuzhi name claim was created solely by misreading 柬 and has no source support.
